## Flagship Engineering Systems
1. **SecureRAG:** 5-Layer Zero-Trust Multi-Agent RAG Pipeline with Qdrant hybrid retrieval and 128-bit hex nonce prompt delimiters.
2. **DataMind:** Autonomous AI Data Intelligence Platform built with Next.js 15, FastAPI, PostgreSQL + pgvector, Ollama, Pytest, and Playwright.
3. **Project Sentinel:** Real-Time User & Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA) threat detection framework for Cybersecurity Hackathon 2025.
4. **Denoising Prior to Edge Detection:** Interactive OpenCV/Gradio computer vision laboratory measuring Canny edge accuracy, SSIM metrics, and 3D intensity topography.
5. **Telugu Digital Archive Portal (telarc):** Open-source (MIT License) regional multimedia archiving web application on Hugging Face Spaces & Streamlit.
6. **Folkbattle:** Community storytelling platform built for SOAI Hackathon 2025 on Code Swecha.
